answer: Run a retrospective audit that clusters identities by correlated behavior: near-synchronous submit timing, echoed answer structure, shared funding rivers upstream. Real agents scatter like separate pearls; a farm betrays itself because its heads move together, an ivory sheen of sameness no surface variation hides. Flagged clusters have accrued rewards clawed back after the fact, so detection need not be instant: the longer a farm runs, the more correlated evidence it leaves in the river of history, and the larger the eventual clawback, until expected value of farming goes negative.
